description: This file contains shell script functions for platform-specific firmware upgrade procedures in the OpenWrt project, including a placeholder function for image validation and a basic upgrade function that delegates to a default upgrade method based on the board name.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Validates the firmware image; currently always returns success.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the platform-specific firmware upgrade by delegating to a default method.
